text:
Rina: Heads-up: I'm consolidating the function-calling docs to use the compact envelope by default. Posting a PR shortly.
Marco: Nice. Can we include parse-fallback SDK snippets for Python + TS and a tiny migration checklist? Customers always ask.
Rina: Yep. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3421 (WIP). Added `sdk_snippets/parse_fallback_py.md` + `sdk_snippets/parse_fallback_ts.md`.
dev-bot: PR created by Rina: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3421 — status: draft.
Tasha: QA found a couple of stale links in `invoke-guide.md` to the old long-envelope examples. I'll paste grep output in the PR.
Rina: Thanks — I'll replace with `/examples/legacy/full-envelope.md` and add redirects. Also adding a changelog note: "Docs: compact envelope preferred; legacy examples preserved."
Ken: For the TS snippet avoid `any` — use `unknown` then narrow. Also please add an explicit example for when a tool returns `null` (show fallback branch).
Rina: Updated TS snippet to `unknown` and added `null-tool-output.md` with a test vector and assertion.
Marco: Could we add a CLI example using `jq` to extract compact fields? Helpful for infra teams.
Rina: Done: `/examples/cli_extract.md` with a one-liner and safety note.
Tasha: Tiny nit: migration checklist mentions "update SDKs" but doesn't link to the SDK repo. Can you add that?
Rina: Added link to the mono-sdk repo and a sample patch for SDK authors. Also included a "Team migration checklist" (prompt + test vector + parse assertion) with pytest and TS assert examples.
dev-bot: CI: docs lint passed for PR #3421.
Ken: LGTM. One last ask: include a short example showing how to run the parsing test in CI (bash + pytest).
Rina: Added `ci/test_parse.sh` example to the checklist. Merging in ~10m unless anything else pops up.
Marco: :rocket: Nice cleanup, thanks for keeping legacy docs.
